description: Collects the tax imposed by the City Treasurer's Office on natural or juridical persons who own or administer real property, including improvements.
typeOfTransaction: G2C/G2B – Government to Client / Government to Business
steps: Obtain a queue number and present the latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment.
Pay the required real property tax and receive the issued Official Receipt.
requirements: Latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment (original or 1 photocopy)
Authorization letter and valid IDs of the owner and representative, if transacting through a representative

detailedRequirements.requirement: Latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment (original or 1 photocopy)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: To be provided by the client

detailedRequirements.requirement: Authorization letter and valid IDs of the owner and representative, if transacting through a representative
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Property owner and government issuing agency

clientSteps.action: Present the latest Official Receipt or Notice of Assessment for verification and computation of the Real Property Tax.
Pay the required fees. The payment will be accepted and an Official Receipt will be issued.

fees.description: AV × 1% × 2 for Basic Tax and Special Education Fund, less any applicable discount if paid by March 31. Delinquent accounts are charged an additional 2% penalty per month of delay, not exceeding 36 months.

feeSchedule.name: Current Real Property Tax
feeSchedule.amount: Assessed Value × 1% × 2 (Basic Tax and Special Education Fund), less any applicable discount

feeSchedule.name: Delinquent Real Property Tax
feeSchedule.amount: Assessed Value × 1% × 2 (Basic Tax and Special Education Fund), plus a 2% penalty per month of delay, not exceeding 36 months

processingTime: 15 minutes, depending on the assessed value

quickInfo.processingTime: 15 minutes, depending on the assessed value

service: Transport Terminal Trip Ticket & Fee Payment
description: Issues trip tickets and collects per-trip terminal fees from public utility vehicles authorized to pick up commuters at the Meycauayan Common Transport Terminal.
officeDivision: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Transport Division)
steps: Request a trip ticket at the Meycauayan Common Transport Terminal.
Pay the applicable terminal fee and receive the Official Receipt.

clientSteps.action: Request a trip ticket. CEEMO personnel will issue the ticket.
Pay the applicable terminal fee. CEEMO personnel will receive the payment and issue an Official Receipt.

fees.description: The fee depends on the type and seating capacity of the public utility vehicle.

feeSchedule.office: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Transport Division)

feeSchedule.name: PUJ terminal fee — 19 seats or fewer
feeSchedule.office: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Transport Division)

feeSchedule.name: PUJ terminal fee — 20 seats or more
feeSchedule.office: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Transport Division)

description: Allows members of the public to check availability, submit a Convention Request Form, and pay the applicable fees to reserve and use the City of Meycauayan Convention Center.
officeDivision: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Market Office)
steps: Verify the availability of the desired date with the City Economic Enterprise Management Office.
Complete and submit the Convention Request Form.
Pay the applicable reservation and rental fees and receive the Official Receipt.

clientSteps.action: Verify the availability of the desired date with CEEMO. Assigned personnel will assist with the request to rent or use the convention center.
Fill out and submit the Convention Request Form. CEEMO personnel will review the completed form.
Pay the applicable rental fees. CEEMO personnel will receive the payment and issue an Official Receipt.

fees.description: A ₱1,000 reservation fee applies. Rental charges vary according to the selected convention-center space.

service: Calvario Public Cemetery Burial Space Application
description: Allows relatives of deceased Meycauayan residents to check the availability of a niche or crypt, complete the burial application and agreement, and pay the applicable cemetery fee.
officeDivision: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Public Cemetery Division)
steps: Check the availability of a niche or crypt at Calvario Public Cemetery.
Complete and submit the burial application form.
Pay the applicable cemetery fee and receive the Official Receipt.
requirements: Applicable Burial, Transfer, Exhumation, or Cremation Permit (original and 1 photocopy)

detailedRequirements.requirement: Applicable Burial, Transfer, Exhumation, or Cremation Permit (original and 1 photocopy)

clientSteps.action: Check the availability of a niche or crypt. The cemetery caretaker will guide the client to an available space.
Fill out the burial application form for review by the cemetery caretaker.
Complete the Contract of Agreement for review.
Pay the applicable cemetery fee and receive the Official Receipt.

fees.description: Charges depend on whether the applicant uses or renews a niche or crypt.

sources.name: City Government of Meycauayan Citizen's Charter 2026 (1st Edition)

description: Processes applications, approval, payment, and scheduling for cremation services at Calvario Public Cemetery.
officeDivision: City Economic Enterprise Management Office (Public Cemetery Division) / Office of the City Mayor
steps: Complete the Cremation Authorization Form and submit all requirements to the Calvario Public Cemetery office.
Proceed to the Office of the City Mayor for approval.
Pay the cremation fee and receive the Official Receipt.
Wait for confirmation of the cremation schedule.
requirements: Valid IDs of the applicant and two witnesses (photocopies)
Embalmer Certificate (original), if the funeral wake exceeds seven days

detailedRequirements.requirement: Valid IDs of the applicant and two witnesses (photocopies)
Embalmer Certificate (original), if the funeral wake exceeds seven days

clientSteps.action: Complete the Cremation Authorization Form and submit it with all requirements to the Calvario Public Cemetery office for checking.
Proceed to the Office of the City Mayor for verification and approval.
Pay the cremation fee and receive the Official Receipt.
Wait while the cremation service is entered into the schedule.

personResponsible: Executive Assistant, Office of the City Mayor

sources.name: City Government of Meycauayan Citizen's Charter 2026 (1st Edition)
